scope: NFL athlete performance support; not medical diagnosis or treatment

cautions: shoulder or arm health signals escalate to qualified staff
contact and lower-limb signals require qualified staff review
soft-tissue or contact signals escalate; system does not diagnose
back, neck, or limb signals require qualified staff review
contact and fatigue signals require qualified staff review
soft-tissue signals escalate; no treatment advice
health-related issues remain with qualified staff

support_boundaries: No diagnosis, injury determination, treatment, medication, or return-to-play decision
Qualified performance and medical staff own health-related decisions
Hydration and nutrition content is general support and defers individualized plans to qualified professionals
Every recommendation retains source, season context, load rationale, and reviewer
Health signals produce escalation rather than automated intervention
